governing_protocol.role: canonical append-only strengthening and claim-admission protocol

scope.included: All JSON artifacts from this Fallout 3 / JANUS Bear / James-Vault112 / Mothership-Zeta birthday / Children-of-Atom / nuclear-UAP branching dialogue that were recoverable by exact GitHub path or exact parent/commit lineage during this audit.
scope.not_claimed: This does not claim review of unrelated repository JSONs, chat-only drafts never committed, or files whose exact identity could not be recovered.
scope.historical_policy: Do not rewrite/delete historical originals. Add append-only successors/overlays and current-authority pointers.
scope.independence_policy: A new version, receipt, summary, or hash record does not create a new independent underlying event.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Wiki/transcript/source assertions and primary ESM observations could appear at the same authority level.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Tag source tier; primary Fallout3.esm structured records supersede public-summary claims when they address the same technical fact.
global_revision_findings.rule: PRIMARY_ESM > DERIVED_PUBLIC_DUMP > WIKI/TRANSCRIPT for shipped-record identity; external scholarship remains authoritative only in its own domain.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: A structurally strong Janus/thematic parallel could visually drift toward authorial-intent language.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Every thematic edge must be typed ANALOGY or INTERPRETATION unless authorial intent is independently sourced.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Proximity, route overlap or co-presence could be mistaken for placement/causal authorship.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Require exact REFR lifecycle, script/linked/reverse-reference semantics and direction before a causal placer edge.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Base object FormID/EditorID and placed reference identity were occasionally conflated.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Every spatial/asset record must separate base_formid/base_editorid from logical_ref_formid/ref_editorid and winning-record provenance.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Persistence of Dad monitor/status notes could be overread as memory persistence.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Primary ESM shows James endpoint/pod graph but no James memory store/carrier bound to the monitor.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Think Machine 3600r lore/backend description could be treated as an exact discovered world object.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Keep architectural/lore reference distinct from exact placed-object identity until a direct record binds it.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: MS08PinkertonLog2 NOTE title 'Mem chip' could be mistaken for the physical chip FormID.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Primary ESM classifies 00024D63 as a terminal log NOTE about a physical carrier; separate technical chip item record was not found.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Pinkerton's 2276 stolen carrier could be rebound to James's 2277 Vault112 session by narrative convenience.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Require a new/rewrite/second-carrier operation in 2277; otherwise binding is rejected.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Quest/session flags such as DadInfo, DadDogInfo or PlayerInTL could be treated as a whole-person snapshot.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Primary ESM state semantics separate identity metadata, session state, world state and autobiographical payload; no autobiographical payload object was found.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Vault112 'User UNKNOWN altered by Braun' could be assigned to James because the motif fits.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Keep UNKNOWN unresolved without exact INFO/stage/reference binding.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Alien technology references, crystals, Skynet or Zeta co-location could be collapsed into one Zetan technology chain.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Require species/source-specific shipped binding.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Russian localization wording could drive lexical conclusions about the birthday poem.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: CG02 English original is lexical authority; translations are secondary reception data.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Pooled same-cell ratios, duplicate override layers, or handpicked scenes could masquerade as game-wide enrichment.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Use effective winning logical REFRs, exact cell-stratified inference, pre-frozen controls and geometry/lifecycle sensitivity.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Fallout symbolic parallels could be misread as the historical origin/evidence basis of Janus Bear product design.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Keep product design lineage independent; Fallout is a contrast/inspiration layer.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Children of Atom's atomic-universe doctrine could be promoted into real-world cosmology.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Treat doctrine as canonical fiction and Everett/decoherence as a separate interpretive framework.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Nuclear/UAP spatial-temporal association could be interpreted as nuclear attraction, extraterrestrial agency or branch detection.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Exposure normalization, matched non-nuclear military controls, pseudo-event dates, covariates and reproduction precede causal interpretation.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Legacy expert-selected priors/likelihoods and Monte Carlo outputs could look like empirical truth probabilities.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Reclassify as ASSUMPTION_CONDITIONAL_MODEL until likelihoods are externally calibrated and held-out predictions succeed.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: Later synthesis scans can rediscover vocabulary introduced by earlier JANUS syntheses.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Prior synthesis is hypothesis memory, not independent source evidence; collapse common authorship/history and require external or primary anchors.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: CI receipts, merge receipts and multiple versions can inflate evidence count.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Receipts validate execution/failure domains but do not multiply the underlying observation.

global_revision_findings.old_risk: NOT_FOUND/FAIL results could be treated as inconvenient gaps rather than model constraints.
global_revision_findings.upgrade: Preserve negative findings as first-class edges that prune hypotheses: no James storage at pod, no separate chip item, no autobiographical MQ04 payload, no direct James placer edge, no literal hidden JANUS.

cross_family_edges.statement: James/Doc and gnome/failsafe motifs coexist in the Tranquility Lane system; this supports motif adjacency, not proof that James later placed gnomes.
